notes.title: The first update of the game
notes.notes:
Greetings to all railroad enthusiasts.

So, the first update to the game has been released, here is what has been added/changed:

[list]
[*] Added new sounds at the train station
[*] Fixed all lighting (now the game should get an extra 5-10 FPS)
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could "fly" around the apartment
[*] Added several new objects on the train track, as well as in the character's apartment
[*] Performed general optimization of the game (LOD's, amount of vegetation, etc.).
[/list]

We are also pleased to announce the development of a new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2757610/TransSiberian_Express/]Trans-Siberian Express[/url].

notes.title: Russian Train Trip 3 game is out!
notes.notes:
Dear friends, we are glad to inform you that our game Russian Train Trip 3 is already available for purchase and download on Steam! This is the third part of our popular series of train travel games in Russia.

This time you will travel from Tyumen to Novosibirsk, where new adventures, interesting characters and an exciting plot await you. You can enjoy the beauty of Russian nature, weather and architecture, as well as learn a lot about the culture and history of our country.

The game has colorful graphics, realistic sound and easy control. We hope that you appreciate our work and enjoy the game. Thank you for your support and interest in our project.

We wish you a pleasant journey!
